about: The Pharmakon puzzle arena: each puzzle is a stimulus script for --test script on a fresh brain, scored by tools/arena/score.py from the monitor report. Words are always learned on their own; relations between words come only from sentences.

puzzles.name: Finish the word
puzzles.tests: 5 words, each learned on its own; hear the first half, does the silence after it bring back the right word (better than the untrained twin's echo)?

puzzles.name: Say the rest
puzzles.tests: Same 5 words; hear the first half, then let it speak: is what it says the rest of the word?

puzzles.name: Continue the sentence
puzzles.tests: Learn three sentences; hear the start of each, does the silence after it bring the word that ended that sentence?

puzzles.name: Make a real choice
puzzles.tests: Two sentences taught equally (the cat sees the dog / bird); asked 8 times, does it really choose, sometimes dog and sometimes bird, each time one answer?

puzzles.name: Keep it after new words
puzzles.tests: Learn 5 words, then 10 more, then a long silence; are the first 5 still completed from their first half?

puzzles.name: Sleep on it
puzzles.tests: The 15 words of 'Keep it', then sleep (replay and unlearning), then the same cues: does sleep help keep them?
